summary: Algonquin Power & Utilities Corp. filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, announcing an agreement to sell its ~64% stake in Chilean water utility Suralis S.A. to Toesca S.A. Administradora General de Fondos, which already owns ~30%. Total proceeds are $126.5 million plus up to $1.5 million earnout. Proceeds will repay debt and fund a $3.2 billion capital plan. Closing expected within two quarters, subject to merger control approval. Centerview Partners LLC advises Algonquin. This divestiture simplifies geographic footprint and recycles capital into core regulated utilities. Watch for regulatory clearance and earnout realization.
